title: Minstrel songs, bands and comics, and age when he started drums
summary: Songs he recalls from minstrel shows, what bands accompanied them, the end man; he started drums at about fifteen.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: While we're on that subject of minstrels, when you were playing on your chairs, do you remember any of the songs you learned?

No, I can't recall the tunes I mean at that time. Oh, yes, yes, I could. Mr. Brown, Mr. Brown had a violin, and that was one of them. Any minstrel numbers? No, minstrel, no more I can recall that, I heard that time, was L.J.'s Field was a number called, Where the Sun Is Always Shining, Don Salt. Where the Sun Is Always Shining, Don Salt. Where my heart is always burning, Don Salt. One of those things, wonderful thing. What kind of song was that, Mr. Brown? Mr. Brown, Mr. Brown, and if I leave, where the round, where the round, something like that. It was a good tune, a good little Ditty. All right, Mr. Brown. And some of the other tunes I just can't recall now. Were they sort of popular tunes at the time? Well, yeah, they were popular tunes at the time, yeah. They were popular tunes at the time, sure.
Well, how would those work in the minstrel shows?

No, it was like memories, I mean, things like that, you know, for a waterfall, for a waterfall, memory, memory, memory, memory, memory. Yeah, they had a lot of tunes. That was a nice tune. Yeah, and tunes like, Old Shantytown, da-da-da-da-da-da. And wait a while, I got some more. Let me see if I can recall. No.
Oh, but they feature these in minstrel shows, is what I was getting at.
Any of those, how would they work?
Not that I know of, no, not that I know of.
Well, how would a minstrel show work?

Well, most everything, minstrel shows, most all the live music, you know. Like that, everything is live, I can't remember. Obviously, I can't recall. All I know of I can recall was that down soft tune, I was telling you, The Weather Suns Always Shining.

Those shows usually have a good band with them? About how big a band would they use? Well, no, I can't recall, I mean, how big was the band at all? Yeah, I mean, if they had a five or six piece band, or only one or two people went with them like a drum and piano, or a whole big band?
Well, I don't know, probably they did carry a director or something like that, and a drummer, you know, maybe a director and a drummer like that, you know. Or maybe a first trumpet player, you know.
Would they have any solo acts on stage, like singing?
Yeah, they would be singing, yeah, yeah, singing and crack a lot of jokes. Always, the end man was always the funny man, the funniest man, the end man.
It was all blacked up, comedians like that. How old were you when you started on drums about?
Well, I would say I was about, let's see, on drums, you know. Yes. Oh, I started playing, you mean, I started playing. I was about 15 years old.
